title: (No AI) Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
author: Emma Roth
content:
![An image of Mico](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/mico-copilot.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Mico is headed to Learn Live. | Image: Microsoft

Microsoft Copilot will no longer show its emotive yellow blob, Mico, when you use the chatbot's voice mode. In a [support page](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/frequently-asked-questions-about-retired-copilot-features), Microsoft says it's going to move Mico to its Learn Live platform, where the avatar will have "more to react to," [as reported earlier by _GeekWire_](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/farewell-mico-microsofts-cute-little-ai-blob-is-going-the-way-of-bob/).

Mico [launched in Copilot's voice mode last October](https://www.theverge.com/news/804106/microsoft-mico-copilot-ai-assistant-clippy), with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman pitching the avatar as a way to [give the chatbot an "identity."](https://www.theverge.com/news/713715/microsoft-copilot-appearance-feature-age-mustafa-suleyman-interview) The blob would react to what you say in real-time, complete with facial expressions and animations.

Mico joins [the long list](https://the-microsoft-windows-xp.fandom.com/wiki/Office_Assistants) of virtual helpers that Microsoft has retired over the years, like Clippy, Cortana, and Rover …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/979871/microsoft-copilot-mico-retired)

title: (No AI) OpenAI is losing its second executive this week
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/gettyimages-2275749204.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Another OpenAI executive is departing. Denise Dresser, who joined OpenAI as its chief revenue officer [in December](https://www.theverge.com/news/841540/openai-slack-ceo-denise-dresser-chief-revenue-officer) after serving as CEO of Slack, will be leaving in the "coming weeks" to "pursue other opportunities," she said in [a team note posted to LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7493699644359630848/). Dali Rajic, president and COO of Wiz, will be taking over the CRO role, [OpenAI says](https://openai.com/index/dali-rajic-chief-revenue-officer/).

Dresser's departure is just the latest in a string of major exits. Earlier this week, special projects lead and former COO Brad Lightcap [announced he would be leaving](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/978048/brad-lightcap-openai-executive-departure). (Dresser had taken over some of Lightcap's work when he moved to the special projects role.) Former [AGI chief Fidji Simo](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/963738/openai-fidji-simo-steps-down-ceo-advisor) and [former CMO …](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/906965/openais-agi-boss-is-taking-a-leave-of-absence)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/979815/openai-denise-dresser-leaving-executive-departure)
